admin.dplugins.title: Discovery Plugins
admin.dplugins.lead: What people can do with a Discover recommendation — a song the discovery network or a paired server suggested that this library does not have. Each plug-in adds one row to the recommendation window. A plug-in that is off, or that cannot run, has no row: nothing is ever shown locked.

admin.dplugins.ytdlpConfigNote: mStream downloads yt-dlp itself when the server has none, or one more than a month behind the newest release, and keeps its copy up to date. To run a particular one, set discoveryPlugins.youtube.binary in the config file — a command on the server’s PATH or a full path; a restart applies it.
admin.dplugins.jobs.applies: Applies to Get it and Send to. Changes apply immediately.
admin.dplugins.jobs.allHint: everyone signed in can download and copy.

admin.dplugins.jobs.uploadNote: A download and a copy from a paired server both put a file into a library, so both need the account’s upload right as well (Users view) and respect “File Uploading” on the Settings view.
admin.dplugins.jobs.noUploadNote: {{users}} may start jobs but cannot upload, so a download or a copy fails for them with that reason until the account may upload. Being an admin does not skip the list.
admin.dplugins.jobs.atOnceNote: Across every plug-in. Each plug-in also limits itself (one copy, one download at a time).
admin.dplugins.jobs.perUserNote: Queued or running at once. Past it a new job is refused until some finish; the runner takes turns between accounts anyway.
admin.dplugins.jobs.folderMaxNote: A folder copied from a paired server with more songs than this is refused, and the user adds its folders one at a time.
admin.dplugins.jobs.historyNote: Done, failed and cancelled rows older than this leave the Activity tab. Files are not touched.
admin.dplugins.jobs.sweeping: Looking for old job rows and leftover staging folders…
admin.dplugins.jobs.passNote: The pass prunes finished job rows past the clock above and removes staging folders a crash left behind. It runs by itself 90 seconds after a start and then every 6 hours.
admin.dplugins.jobs.sweepResult: Pruned {{jobs}} old job rows and removed {{staging}} leftover staging folders.

Which yt-dlp runs is not set here: it is discoveryPlugins.youtube.binary in the config file, and the plug-in’s row shows the one in use.

admin.dplugins.num.maxConcurrent.help: 1 – 16. Downloads and copies are disk and network work; a small number keeps playback smooth. Takes effect on the next job, no restart.

admin.dplugins.num.maxQueuedPerUser.help: 1 – 500. Past it a new job is refused until some finish. The runner takes turns between accounts besides, so one long queue never holds the others. Takes effect at once.
admin.dplugins.num.maxFolderSongs.title: Largest folder to add
admin.dplugins.num.maxFolderSongs.label: Songs one folder copied from a paired server may hold
admin.dplugins.num.maxFolderSongs.help: 1 – 100000. A folder with more songs is refused with the count, and the user adds its folders one at a time. One folder job holds the copy slot for as long as it runs. Takes effect on the next job.
dpage.bar.seedsWait: The seeds show here once the server answers.
dpage.seeds.title: Based on what you finished
dpage.seeds.pickBanner: Click a song to add it to the seeds
dpage.library.nothing: Nothing new in your library sounds like these songs.
dpage.peers.quiet: Nothing from your connected servers right now.
dpage.state.loading: Finding music that sounds like what you finished…
dpage.state.nothingFinished: Finish a few songs and this page learns your taste
dpage.state.nothingFinishedBody: Discover seeds itself from songs you play to the end. Skipped songs never count. Until there are some, here are suggestions around a random pick from your library — Another pick tries a different one.
dpage.state.allDropped: Every song you finished was dropped from the seeds
dpage.state.allDroppedBody: Until you bring one back with Edit seeds (also under More options), here are suggestions around a random pick from your library.
dpage.state.scanPending: This server hasn’t analyzed any music yet
dpage.state.scanPendingBody: Suggestions appear once the discovery scan has run over your library. It runs after a library scan; an admin can start it from Admin → Database → Enrichment.
dpage.state.seedsListedAnyway: your seeds are under More options anyway — only the sources wait
dpage.state.off: Sonic discovery has been switched off on this server.
dpage.state.offBody: An admin turns it on under Admin → Database → Enrichment → Discovery embeddings. Your listening history is kept; this page wakes up with the flag.
dpage.state.unavailable: Discover isn’t available for this account.
dpage.state.unavailableBody: The page is seeded by an account’s own play history on this server, and this one has none here (a federation key, a guest or a jukebox).
dpage.state.failed: Couldn’t load suggestions — the server didn’t answer.
dpage.source.failed: Couldn’t reach this source — try again.
peerRecs.turnOn.shares: Shares your library's metadata, never its audio, on the public discovery network, with this server's name and description.
peerRecs.turnOn.collection: Also turns on discovery data collection.
peerRecs.turnOn.name: Server name
peerRecs.turnOn.unavailable: The discovery network isn't available on this platform.
peerRecs.turnOn.nameNotSaved: The network is on, but the server name wasn't saved.
peerRecs.turnOn.descriptionNotSaved: The network is on, but the description wasn't saved.
